Name: CP - Sunkist
Author: Rufusio
Description:
Me and my friend thoguht it was good idea to try to add Suknkist, a dog from "Half-Life VR but the AI is Self-Aware"  into our game. And one of us went "why not make it a mod", so here it is. Its just a very compressed png of the dog. Literally none of us have made any mods before. Have fun.


To install the mod just extract the file into your Mods folder and run the game using SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Sunkist Dog
Manifest.Description: Turns dog into bad Sunkist png
